messages:
maria: heads-up — perf-checker flagged a regression on main after the merge of #18901. kv cache microbench (kv_lookup_latency) is well over threshold. :grimacing:
ci-bot: perf-checker summary (thread 8890012345): bench=kv_lookup_latency, baseline=18.4ms, current=25.7ms, diff=+39.7% (threshold +10%) ; kv_hit_rate baseline=0.72 -> current=0.48 (-33%). Full artifact: https://ci.redwood/perf/8890012345
ryan: yikes. can somebody repro locally? or is this flaky in CI only? :eyes:
taylor: repro'd locally on my m100 dev machine. ran the small kv microbench 10x. median went 18ms -> 26ms consistently. I can share the run log.
lee: quick grep points at the kernel selector change in the runtime that landed in the PR — commit 3f2a9b4. it adjusts allocator scoring for batching affinity, might be starving the kv prefetch path.
maria: 3f2a9b4 also touched the scheduler hotpath? i remember a tiny refactor.
ryan: can we bisect to be sure? i'll start a git bisect on the PR branch vs main. will post commands.
ryan: ```
git checkout main
git bisect start --term-good=baseline --term-bad=regressed
git bisect good v2026-05-01
git bisect bad HEAD
# run our microbench harness (short): ./tools/bench_kv --iters 100 --seq 512
```
taylor: running bisect step locally now. pulling test harness. also capturing perf flamegraph.
lee: quick telemetry: the KV cache miss path allocs spike when the allocator change is present, stepping memory churn up ~2x. that increases coldpath cost.
anika: recommend holding the release of runtime v0.21 until we triage. put the rollout gate to blocked. i added the hold tag on the release dashboard. :no_entry:
maria: agreed — marking the merge as rollback-candidate. ry an, if bisect confirms 3f2a9b4, can you prepare a minimal revert?
ryan: will do. if bisect proves it, i'll open a revert PR and run the same microbench in CI before merging.
taylor: for context here's the perf excerpt from my local run:
```
# baseline (before 3f2a9b4)
kv_lookup_latency: 18.4ms (median)
kv_hit_rate: 0.72
# with 3f2a9b4
kv_lookup_latency: 25.7ms (median)
kv_hit_rate: 0.48
# tail p95 latency: 42ms -> 81ms
```
lee: thanks. also cross-check kernel selection logs: when the allocator scoring changes, a subset of requests now get routed to quantized kernel path with different prefetch timing — that could explain increased misses.
anika: can we run the microbench with instrumentation to log allocator buckets? I can add a small opt-in flag to bench_kv today.
ryan: bisect step returned candidate: 3f2a9b4 is bad. doing one more confirm run to be safe.
ryan: confirm done — it reproduces on two machines. opening revert PR now (will link).
maria: perfect. once revert PR is up let's gate it through quick perf CI and hold rollout until we get green. thanks everyone for swift triage. :clap:
ci-bot: triggered perf CI: https://ci.redwood/builds/8890012360 (revert-pr-18901-rollback) — running bench_kv with 5 parallel shards.
taylor: i'll help review the revert and add a note to the changelog explaining the allocator interaction. also adding a follow-up ticket to redesign scoring so it doesn't affect prefetch/timing.
lee: filing an observability follow-up: add a KV-prefetch / allocator bucket counter to runtime telemetry (small metric) so next time we can alert earlier.
anika: created ticket INF-4523 to track telemetry + safer rollout plan.
ryan: revert PR is up: https://github.com/redwood/runtime/pull/18910 — CI running.
maria: once CI is green, let's merge revert and re-run canary in staging. hold on any further merges to main that affect the kernel selector until we have metrics.
ryan: ack. will coordinate revert merge, then follow-up patch with unit tests for the allocator scoring edge-case.
taylor: note for postmortem: microbench threshold is doing its job catching regressions. we should document which invariants (kv hit-rate) map to user-visible latency and add a smoke-eval for long-tail p95.
maria: agreed. thanks all for quick response. I'll draft a short incident note after revert lands.
ci-bot: update: revert PR perf CI passed (8890012376). ready for merge.
anika: merging revert now. :white_check_mark:
maria: closing thread once rollout is back to healthy.
